import Mathlib

inductive BinarySearchTree : Type
| Empty : BinarySearchTree
| Node : Int → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree → BinarySearchTree
deriving Inhabited

def view (t : BinarySearchTree) : Set Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => ∅
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r => view l ∪ view r ∪ {v}

def is_bst (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Empty => True
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v l r =>
    (∀ x ∈ view l, x < v) ∧
    is_bst l ∧
    (∀ x ∈ view r, x > v) ∧
    is_bst r

def get_left (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ l _ => some l
  | _ => none

def get_right (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option BinarySearchTree :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ r => some r
  | _ => none

def get_val (t : BinarySearchTree) : Option Int :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v _ _ => some v
  | _ => none

def BinarySearchTree.is_node (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_precond (t : BinarySearchTree) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  is_bst t ∧ 
  BinarySearchTree.is_node t ∧ 
  (match get_left t with | some l => BinarySearchTree.is_node l | none => False)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def zig (t : BinarySearchTree) 
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) : BinarySearchTree :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  match t with
  | BinarySearchTree.Node v (BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll lr) r =>
      BinarySearchTree.Node lv ll (BinarySearchTree.Node v lr r)
  | other => other
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def zig_postcond (t : BinarySearchTree) (result : BinarySearchTree)
    (_ : zig_precond t) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_bst result ∧
  view result = view t ∧
  -- Structural properties
  get_val result = get_val (get_left t).get! ∧
  BinarySearchTree.is_node (get_right result).get! ∧
  get_val (get_right result).get! = get_val t
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem zig_postcond_satisfied (t : BinarySearchTree)
    (h_precond : zig_precond t) :
    zig_postcond t (zig t h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  rcases t with _ | ⟨v, l, r⟩
  · simp [BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  rcases l with _ | ⟨lv, ll, lr⟩
  · simp [get_left, BinarySearchTree.is_node] at h_precond
  obtain ⟨hbst, -, -⟩ := id h_precond
  simp only [is_bst] at hbst
  obtain ⟨hl_lt, ⟨hll_lt, hll, hlr_gt, hlr⟩, hr_gt, hr⟩ := hbst
  have hlv : lv < v := hl_lt lv (by simp only [view, Set.mem_union]; tauto)
  have hlr_lt : ∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v := fun x hx =>
    hl_lt x (by simp only [view, Set.mem_union]; tauto)
  simp only [zig, zig_postcond, is_bst, get_val, get_left, get_right, Option.get!_some]
  refine ⟨⟨hll_lt, hll, ?_, hlr_lt, hlr, hr_gt, hr⟩, ?_, trivial, trivial, trivial⟩
  · intro x hx
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
    rcases hx with (hx | hx) | hx
    · exact hlr_gt x hx
    · exact lt_trans hlv (hr_gt x hx)
    · exact hx ▸ hlv
  · ext x
    simp only [view, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_singleton_iff]
    tauto
  -- !benchmark @end proof

Verified on the second compiler check.

**Approach**

`zig` is a single right rotation, implemented by pattern match with the (unreachable) degenerate shapes returning the tree unchanged:

```
Node v (Node lv ll lr) r  ↦  Node lv ll (Node v lr r)
```

**Proof** (`Solution.lean:79-102`)

- `rcases` on `t` and its left child; the `Empty` cases are killed by `simp` on `zig_precond` (`is_node` reduces to `False`).
- From `is_bst t` destructured: `hl_lt` (everything in the left subtree `< v`), the left child's own invariant, and `hr_gt`/`hr`.
- Key facts: `lv < v` (since `lv ∈ view (Node lv ll lr)`) and `∀ x ∈ view lr, x < v`.
- New root invariant: `ll` values stay `< lv` unchanged; for the new right child `Node v lr r`, values in `view lr` are `> lv` by the old invariant, values in `view r` are `> v > lv` by transitivity, and `v > lv` itself.
- View equality is `ext x` plus unfolding `view` — the two shapes differ only by associativity/commutativity of `∪`, so `tauto` closes it.
- The three structural goals (`get_val result = get_val` of the old left child, the new right child is a node, its value is the old root's) reduce definitionally after `simp`, hence `trivial`.

No `sorry`, `axiom`, `partial`, or other bypasses; only the four marker regions were edited.
